summary: XORTX Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, attaching a news release announcing a planned Investigational New Drug (IND) application to the U.S. FDA for its XRx-026 gout program, targeting a fourth-quarter 2026 submission based on the XORLO oxypurinol formulation. The company cites a U.S. gout market opportunity exceeding USD$700 million annually, referencing febuxostat's prior USD$450 million peak sales and its cardiovascular boxed warning. No securities transaction, shareholder action, or corporate control event is involved; the filing is a routine operational/regulatory update, so no deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or advisor apply. Watch clinical execution and financing risk.
